name: smart-sprint-planner
title: Smart Sprint Planner
description: Multi-role sprint planning plugin for YouTrack 2024.3+. Supports 9 functional roles with separate composition tables, resources, and history snapshots. Plugin settings live in a dedicated widget with server-side authorization.
changeNotes: v1.7.1 — UX polish + pre-existing kpe whitelist fix. Settings: sections collapse-by-default with auto-expand on nav-chip click; save button now fixed at bottom (sticky regression fix); rescan stub button tooltip works (wrap-span pattern). Toast UX: moved to bottom-right above save row, never blocks underlying clicks. i18n audit: all workflow messages and toasts go through localization layer. Critical: kpe whitelist now accepts canonical English grade keys (Intern/Junior/Middle/Senior) — pre-existing v1.4.1 bug that caused invalid_settings_structure on settings save in clean projects. See CHANGELOG.md.

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Sprint composition planning, task allocation, history of confirmed sprints with working drafts. Settings are accessible via the «Plugin settings» button in the page header for members of settingsManagerGroup.
